problem.accent_invalid: Enter the accent colour as a hexadecimal code, for example #0078d4 or #07d.
problem.asset_unknown: One of the selected images is no longer available. Upload it again.
problem.assignment_exists: This user or group already has this role with the same scope.
problem.assignment_invalid: This assignment is not allowed. Check that the role can be assigned, that the scope fits the role and that the expiry date is within range.
problem.bad_request: The request could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
problem.branding_conflict: The appearance was changed by someone else since you opened this page. Reload to see the latest settings, then apply your change again.
problem.break_glass_locked: Too many failed break-glass attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
problem.csrf_invalid: The security token for this page is missing or has expired. Reload the page and try again.
problem.cursor_invalid: This list position is no longer valid, for example because it expired. The list starts again from the first page.
problem.escalation_denied: You cannot grant more access than you hold yourself. Choose a role or scope within your own access.
problem.graph_throttled: Microsoft is slowing requests down. Try again in {seconds} s.
problem.graph_unavailable: Microsoft Graph did not answer. Try again in a moment.
problem.image_corrupt: This image could not be read. Try another file, or export it again from the program that made it.
problem.image_empty: This file is empty or has nothing to show. Choose another image.
problem.image_pixels_exceeded: This image has too many pixels. Use a smaller image.
problem.image_processing_busy: The panel is busy processing other images. Try again in {seconds} s.
problem.image_processing_timeout: Processing this image took too long. Try a simpler or smaller image.
problem.image_type_unsupported: This file type is not supported. Use a PNG, JPEG or SVG image.
problem.import_invalid: This file is not a valid appearance export. Use a file that was exported from this panel.
problem.import_unsupported_version: This export was made by a version of the panel that this version cannot read. Export it again from a compatible version.
problem.internal_error: Something went wrong in the panel. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, contact your administrator and mention the request ID.
problem.last_owner_protected: This change would leave the panel without an Owner. Assign another Owner first.
problem.method_not_allowed: This action is not supported here.
problem.not_found: We could not find what you asked for.
problem.org_name_invalid: The organisation name is not valid. Use a short name with letters, numbers or symbols, and without control or invisible characters.
problem.origin_not_allowed: This page was opened at an address the panel does not expect, so the change was refused. Open the panel at {origin}, or set PUBLIC_BASE_URL to the address you use.
problem.payload_too_large: The request is too large to process. Try a smaller file or less data.
problem.permission_denied: You do not have permission to do this.
problem.policy_not_applied: The panel could not apply the access rules to this request, so it was stopped. Try again, and tell your administrator if it keeps happening.
problem.precondition_required: The change could not be checked against the current settings. Reload the page and try again.
problem.principal_unknown: Microsoft Entra does not know this user or group. Check the name or choose it from the directory again.
problem.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds} s.
problem.request_header_fields_too_large: The request headers are too large. Clear the cookies for this site and try again.
problem.request_timeout: The request took too long to arrive. Check your connection and try again.
problem.secrets_unavailable: The panel cannot use its encryption key or certificate. Check APP_KEY or APP_KEY_FILE and restart the container; sign-in is unavailable until then.
problem.session_expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
problem.setup_required: Setup is not finished yet, so this is not available. Finish the setup wizard first.
problem.setup_step_busy: Another setup step is still running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
problem.setup_step_not_ready: An earlier setup step has not succeeded yet. Complete the steps in order.
problem.setup_token_invalid: The setup token is not correct. Copy it again from the token file or the SETUP_TOKEN variable and try again.
problem.setup_token_locked: Too many wrong setup tokens. Unlocking is blocked; try again in {seconds} s.
problem.shutting_down: The panel is restarting or shutting down. Try again in a few seconds.
problem.staging_quota_exceeded: Too many uploaded images are waiting to be applied. Apply your changes, or wait until the unused uploads expire.
problem.step_up_required: This action needs a fresh sign-in with multi-factor authentication. Confirm your identity and try again.
problem.storage_busy: The panel's database is busy. Try again in a moment.
problem.storage_unavailable: The panel cannot read or write its data right now. Check that the data volume is mounted, has free space and is writable by user 65532 (for example with chown 65532:65532), then try again.
problem.svg_doctype_forbidden: This SVG contains a DOCTYPE or ENTITY declaration, which is not allowed. Remove it and upload the file again.
problem.svg_not_wellformed: This SVG file is not valid. Check that it opens correctly and has a width and height or a viewBox.
problem.svg_text_unsupported: This SVG contains text. Convert the text to outlines (paths) and upload the file again.
problem.svg_too_complex: This SVG is too complex. Simplify it, or use a PNG image.
problem.tenant_mismatch: This account belongs to another Microsoft 365 tenant than the one this panel is connected to. Sign in with an account of the connected tenant.
problem.unauthenticated: You are not signed in. Sign in and try again.
problem.unknown: Something went wrong (code {code}, request ID {requestId}). Try again, or give these details to your administrator.
problem.unsupported_media_type: The request was sent in a format the panel does not accept.
problem.validation_failed: Some of the values are not valid. Check the highlighted fields and try again.
